verdicts.reason: The two are almost identical: each crops tightly into the shelf, curtain and sofa area, so the original's vase, yellow side table and glassware are lost, and the zoomed photo looks soft. Each puts the purple headline box at the vertical centre with a busy shelf above and an empty blurred sofa below. A wins only slightly because its box has more even side margins (about 26px) and roomier padding around the headline; B's box sits closer to the canvas edges (about 18px) and its slightly bigger headline crowds the box, so the box no longer feels as well proportioned to the canvas.
